P01.rationale: No portrait or person image appears anywhere on the generated page; it is entirely text-based.

P05.rationale: The right column has a client name ('Hanisch & Klein') but no portrait image — only a blank space where a photo would go.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus beyond a single pull-quote attribution.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph ('66') appears in the right column before the testimonial, but it is the only decorative typographic element and is modest in scale.

P11.rationale: The right column lists three outcome statements (e.g., '100 % automatisiert') as text labels, but there are no actual charts, before/after bars, or cost-math visualisations.

P12.rationale: The left column is well-filled with structured body text, but the right column has large empty white gaps above the outcome list and above the testimonial, making the overall layout feel under-filled.

P13.rationale: The page background is completely flat white with no texture, gradient, or atmospheric treatment.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable; scored 0 as absent.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: There are no images at all, so stock-photo genericness is not an issue, though the absence of any specific imagery keeps it generic by default.

N08.rationale: The right column contains two notably large empty white regions — one above the outcome metrics block and one between the metrics and the testimonial — constituting significant dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No photos are present on the page, so there is no risk of text sitting on a busy image without a scrim.
